digest.component_or_area: code-review gate dispatch and project criteria routing
propositions: Project code-review criteria's applies_to field is stored and validated in overlay.py but never read during dispatch, causing all project criteria to run regardless of changed files.
The dispatch path in gate_dispatch.py:427-447 filters project criteria by criterion_id and exec type only, ignoring applies_to and changed files, bypassing the workflow's membership gating.
Project criteria are appended after req.criteria in batch_runner.py, structurally sidestepping the YAML when: expressions that govern built-in criteria.
applies_to lacks shape validation in _validate_routing_entry, allowing malformed values (bare strings, non-lists, non-string elements) to silently narrow to empty list instead of failing loudly.
Plan-review project criteria ARE gated on applies_to via registry.project_trigger_fires() and file_impact_globs, creating an asymmetry with code-review that has no equivalent gating.
